internal_fields.name: inventorySlots
internal_fields.role: Ordered Slot models mapping window slot IDs to inventories

internal_fields.name: inventoryItemStacks
internal_fields.role: Last-sent snapshot for change detection

internal_fields.name: crafters
internal_fields.role: ICrafting viewers receiving slot and progress updates

internal_fields.name: dragSlots
internal_fields.role: Slots collected during mode-5 drag-split gesture

internal_fields.name: windowId
internal_fields.role: Window identifier multiplexing client/server containers

methods.detail: Handles pickup/place, shift transfer, hotbar swap, creative clone, drop, and double-click merge. Mode 5 manages dragEvent state machine. Server calls it from C0E click processing.
methods.name: slotClick
methods.purpose: Implements all window click modes 0-6 including drag-split.

methods.detail: Compares each Slot stack with inventoryItemStacks via areItemStacksEqual. On change copies stack and calls ICrafting.sendSlotContents. Drives S2F and S30 updates.
methods.name: detectAndSendChanges
methods.purpose: Diffs slots against snapshots and notifies crafting listeners.

methods.detail: Base returns slot stack; subclasses implement mergeItemStack ranges. Result determines what server sends back to client window.
methods.name: transferStackInSlot
methods.purpose: Shift-click quick-move hook overridden by subclasses.

methods.detail: First pass stacks onto same item/tag, second pass fills empty slots. Honors max stack size and direction flag. Core of shift-click behavior.
methods.name: mergeItemStack
methods.purpose: Merges stack into slot range respecting stackability and limits.

methods.detail: Adds ICrafting listener, calls updateCraftingInventory with getInventory, then detectAndSendChanges. Maps to S2D open plus S30 bulk.
methods.name: onCraftGuiOpened
methods.purpose: Registers a viewer and syncs full inventory initially.

methods.detail: If InventoryPlayer cursor stack non-null, drops via dropPlayerItemWithRandomChoice and clears. Prevents item duplication on close.
methods.name: onContainerClosed
methods.purpose: Drops held cursor stack when window closes.

methods.detail: Increments transactionID counter. NetHandlerPlayServer echoes it in S32 confirm; client C0F uses it for resync.
methods.name: getNextTransactionID
methods.purpose: Allocates short action number for click confirmations.

methods.detail: Subclasses check block distance or entity liveness. EntityPlayer.onUpdate closes screen when false. Triggers S2E close.
methods.name: canInteractWith
methods.purpose: Abstract distance/validity check for open window.

Container.overview: Abstract server-side model for window inventories like chests, furnaces, and player inventory. Owns Slot list, item-stack snapshots, drag state, and ICrafting listeners. Implements full click/drag/shift-click/number-key/drop logic in slotClick. Change detection fans out via detectAndSendChanges.

internal_fields.name: dataWatcher
internal_fields.role: Watched indices 0-4 for flags, air, name, silent; syncs metadata

internal_fields.name: boundingBox
internal_fields.role: Current AABB used for collision and render culling

internal_fields.name: posX/posY/posZ + motion
internal_fields.role: Authoritative kinematics replicated by tracker packets

internal_fields.name: entityId
internal_fields.role: Runtime numeric ID used in spawn and entity packets

internal_fields.name: ridingEntity/riddenByEntity
internal_fields.role: Vehicle chain driving attach packets and position updates

methods.detail: Queries World.getCollidingBoundingBoxes per axis, applies step-up logic, sneak edge handling, and fall callbacks. Sets motion to zero on impact. Basis for S14/S18 movement.
methods.name: moveEntity
methods.purpose: Collision-resolves displacement and updates onGround and flags.

methods.detail: Handles portal countdown and travelToDimension, fire decay and damage, lava ignition, void kill, and DataWatcher burning flag sync. Calls water and sprint particles.
methods.name: onEntityUpdate
methods.purpose: Per-tick base logic for portal, fire, lava, and flags.

methods.detail: Centers box on x/z with full height. Used by spawn, teleport, and NBT load. Does not perform collision checks.
methods.name: setPosition
methods.purpose: Sets pos and rebuilds AABB from width/height.

methods.detail: Builds eye pos and look vector then calls World.rayTraceBlocks with returnLastUncollidable true. Used for block targeting.
methods.name: rayTrace
methods.purpose: Eye-to-look block raycast for interaction reach.

methods.detail: Writes Pos/Motion/Rotation lists plus Dimension, CustomName, Silent, and nested Riding tag. Calls abstract writeEntityToNBT. Basis for chunk save.
methods.name: writeToNBT
methods.purpose: Serializes pos, motion, rotation, fire, UUID, and rider.

methods.detail: Clamps motion, restores pos/rotation, UUID variants, name visibility, and silent flag. Calls readEntityFromNBT then repositions. Used on chunk load.
methods.name: readFromNBT
methods.purpose: Restores entity state and re-establishes bounding box.

methods.detail: Clears deltas, breaks old riddenBy links, prevents cycles, sets ridingEntity/riddenByEntity pair. Server broadcasts via S1B attach.
methods.name: mountEntity
methods.purpose: Attaches or detaches rider/vehicle links.

methods.detail: Bit operations on index 0; isBurning, isSneaking, isSprinting read through it. Watched index 0 syncs via S1C metadata.
methods.name: getFlag/setFlag
methods.purpose: Packs burning/sneak/ride/sprint/eat/invisible into DataWatcher byte 0.

Entity.overview: Base class for all world objects with position, motion, bounding box, and DataWatcher flags. Implements collision-resolved moveEntity, portal/fire/water ticks, riding, NBT save/load, and eye/look ray helpers. Server tracks pos/motion for spawn and delta packets; client interpolates via setPositionAndRotation2.

internal_fields.name: inventory/openContainer
internal_fields.role: Main inventory plus active window driving slot packets

internal_fields.name: foodStats
internal_fields.role: Hunger/exhaustion ticked server-side, synced via health packet

internal_fields.name: experience/Level/Total
internal_fields.role: XP bar state synced via S1F set experience

internal_fields.name: sleeping/playerLocation
internal_fields.role: Bed occupancy driving S0A use-bed broadcast

internal_fields.name: capabilities
internal_fields.role: Fly/speed/edit flags synced via abilities packet

methods.detail: Decrements itemInUseCount to onItemUseFinish, advances sleepTimer, updates FoodStats server-side, clamps world border, closes invalid openContainer.
methods.name: onUpdate
methods.purpose: Ticks item use, sleep, food, stats, and container validity.

methods.detail: Computes attackDamage plus enchant modifier, crit multiplier, knockback and fire aspect. Calls attackEntityFrom, sends S12 velocity sync for MP victims, applies thorns and stats.
methods.name: attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem
methods.purpose: Melee pipeline for damage, knockback, fire, and durability.

methods.detail: Respects creative disableDamage, wakes sleeper, scales by difficulty, halves blocked damage, applies armor/potion/absorption then health and exhaustion.
methods.name: attackEntityFrom/damageEntity
methods.purpose: Applies difficulty scaling, blocking, armor, and potion reduction.

methods.detail: Checks dimension, daytime, distance, and nearby mobs; shrinks box and positions in bed. Wake restores size, clears occupied flag, optionally sets spawn. Maps to S0A bed.
methods.name: trySleep/wakeUpPlayer
methods.purpose: Validates bed use and manages sleep state and spawn.

methods.detail: Plays drink/eat sounds, spawns ITEM_CRACK particles, calls onItemUseFinish to replace held stack and clear itemInUse. Status 9 mirrors it client-side.
methods.name: onItemUseFinish/updateItemUse
methods.purpose: Completes eating/drinking and spawns consumption particles.

methods.detail: Adds score, converts amount via xpBarCap thresholds 7/37/112 formulas, loops level-ups with levelup sound. Server pushes via S1F experience.
methods.name: addExperience/xpBarCap
methods.purpose: Accumulates XP and levels with cap curve.

methods.detail: Offsets from eye height, sets motion from yaw/pitch plus randomness, sets thrower for stats. World.spawnEntityInWorld replicates via S0E.
methods.name: dropItem/joinEntityItemWithWorld
methods.purpose: Spawns EntityItem with throw physics and pickup delay.

methods.detail: Stores Inventory list, SelectedItemSlot, Sleeping/SleepTimer, XpP/Level/Total/Seed, Score, SpawnXYZ, FoodStats, capabilities, EnderItems. Restores on login/respawn.
methods.name: readEntityFromNBT/writeEntityToNBT
methods.purpose: Persists inventory, XP, spawn, food, and ender chest.

EntityPlayer.overview: Living player with inventory, ender chest, food, XP, sleep, and combat state. Extends EntityLivingBase with DataWatcher skin/score/absorption fields. Implements item use, attack pipeline with enchant/crit/knockback, bed logic, NBT persistence, and score/team helpers.

packet_usage.trigger: Melee knockback on EntityPlayerMP victim; restores motion after velocity packet

internal_fields.name: thePlayer/theWorld
internal_fields.role: Local player and client world mutated by ticks and packets

internal_fields.name: scheduledTasks
internal_fields.role: Main-thread queue drained each frame for packet callbacks

internal_fields.name: myNetworkManager
internal_fields.role: Active connection used while world null or integrated login

internal_fields.name: currentScreen
internal_fields.role: Top GUI intercepting input and pausing world

internal_fields.name: playerController
internal_fields.role: Sends block/entity interactions as C-packets

methods.detail: Calls startGame once, then loops runGameLoop until running false. Catches memory, reported, and unexpected throwables into crash screens.
methods.name: run
methods.purpose: Outer startup and loop guard with crash handling.

methods.detail: Updates timer, drains scheduledTasks, runs runTick per elapsedTicks, renders via EntityRenderer, syncs display, updates debug FPS and pause state.
methods.name: runGameLoop
methods.purpose: Frame driver for timer, ticks, render, and FPS limit.

methods.detail: Handles mouse/keyboard, hotbar, inventory key sending C16 open-inventory, click/rightClick dispatch, joinEntityInSurroundings, world.updateEntities/tick, and sound updates.
methods.name: runTick
methods.purpose: Client tick for input, controller, world, and GUI.

methods.detail: Cleans NetHandler, stops integrated server if unloading, sets renderGlobal/effectRenderer world, spawns thePlayer or clears it. Called on login/logout/respawn.
methods.name: loadWorld
methods.purpose: Swaps WorldClient and rebuilds player/render state.

methods.detail: Creates IntegratedServer, waits for loop, provides local NetworkManager client, sends C00Handshake then C00 login start. Stores myNetworkManager.
methods.name: launchIntegratedServer
methods.purpose: Starts local server and connects via loopback channel.

methods.detail: If off thread enqueues ListenableFutureTask into scheduledTasks drained in runGameLoop; if on thread runs immediately. Used by NetHandler packet handling.
methods.name: addScheduledTask
methods.purpose: Thread-safe queue for main-thread execution.

methods.detail: Returns thePlayer.sendQueue if player exists else null. Used to enqueue C-packets like C16 inventory and movement.
methods.name: getNetHandler
methods.purpose: Accessor for client play handler via player queue.

methods.detail: Closes old screen, defaults to main menu or game-over, sets resolution, toggles ingame focus and sound pause. Drives inventory and pause menus.
methods.name: displayGuiScreen
methods.purpose: Manages GUI stack and mouse focus transitions.

Minecraft.overview: Client singleton owning game loop, window, renderers, player, and world. run/runGameLoop/runTick pump scheduled tasks, input, controller, world ticks, and rendering. Holds thePlayer/theWorld, NetHandler access, GUI stack, and display management. Also bootstraps integrated server connections.

packet_usage.trigger: Integrated-server login: C00Handshake then C00 login start via local channel
Inventory key opens GuiInventory and signals open-inventory achievement

internal_fields.name: channel
internal_fields.role: Active Netty channel carrying encoded packets

internal_fields.name: packetListener
internal_fields.role: INetHandler receiving decoded packets via channelRead0

internal_fields.name: outboundPacketsQueue
internal_fields.role: Buffer for sends before channel open, drained in order

internal_fields.name: direction
internal_fields.role: CLIENTBOUND or SERVERBOUND expected flow for this endpoint

internal_fields.name: terminationReason
internal_fields.role: Disconnect message surfaced via getExitMessage

methods.detail: Checks channel open then calls processPacket(packetListener). Swallows ThreadQuickExitException used to abort handling. All play/login/status packets flow through here.
methods.name: channelRead0
methods.purpose: Inbound entry point that dispatches received Packet to current INetHandler.

methods.detail: If channel open, flushes queue then dispatchPacket; else buffers under write lock. Overload accepts Netty future listeners. Used for every serverbound and clientbound send.
methods.name: sendPacket
methods.purpose: Queues or immediately dispatches an outbound packet.

methods.detail: Compares EnumConnectionState from packet vs channel attr; disables auto-read on change. If on event loop writes directly, else schedules task. Adds failure listener.
methods.name: dispatchPacket
methods.purpose: Writes packet to channel, handling protocol switches and threading.

methods.detail: Takes read lock and polls outboundPacketsQueue calling dispatchPacket. Called from sendPacket and processReceivedPackets. Ensures login/handshake ordering.
methods.name: flushOutboundQueue
methods.purpose: Drains buffered packets queued before channel was open.

methods.detail: Flushes outbound queue, ticks packetListener if ITickable, then flushes channel. Called by client runTick and server loops.
methods.name: processReceivedPackets
methods.purpose: Per-tick pump for network and packet listener logic.

methods.detail: Stores EnumConnectionState in channel attr and enables auto-read. Called on channelActive as HANDSHAKING and on protocol upgrade during dispatch.
methods.name: setConnectionState
methods.purpose: Sets protocol state attribute controlling codec routing.

methods.detail: Selects NIO or Epoll channel, installs timeout/splitter/decoder/prepender/encoder/handler. Uses CLIENTBOUND decoder and SERVERBOUND encoder.
methods.name: createNetworkManagerAndConnect
methods.purpose: Builds client TCP pipeline and connects to remote server.

methods.detail: Adds decrypt before splitter and encrypt before prepender using CryptManager ciphers. Sets isEncrypted flag. Triggered after login encryption response.
methods.name: enableEncryption
methods.purpose: Inserts cipher codecs for encrypted session after login key exchange.

methods.detail: Adds NettyCompressionDecoder/Encoder before decoder/encoder if threshold >=0, else removes them. Mirrors login compression negotiation.
methods.name: setCompressionTreshold
methods.purpose: Enables or disables Netty compression codecs dynamically.

NetworkManager.overview: Netty-based transport for all Minecraft connections, extending SimpleChannelInboundHandler<Packet>. Owns the Channel, packet listener (INetHandler), and queued outbound packets with read/write locks. Handles connection-state switching, encryption, compression, and local vs TCP channels. Client and server both pump it via processReceivedPackets and sendPacket.

internal_fields.name: loadedEntityList/playerEntities
internal_fields.role: Ticked entities and player subset for queries and sleep

internal_fields.name: chunkProvider
internal_fields.role: Chunk source backing block, light, and entity storage

internal_fields.name: worldAccesses
internal_fields.role: Listeners receiving block, sound, particle, entity events

internal_fields.name: isRemote
internal_fields.role: Client vs server branch for logic and packet fan-out

internal_fields.name: worldInfo/worldBorder
internal_fields.role: Time, spawn, rules, and border constraining validity

methods.detail: Validates coords, delegates to Chunk, handles light check, markBlockForUpdate for render, and neighbor/comparator updates. Flags control notify vs client sync. Basis for S22/S23.
methods.name: getBlockState/setBlockState
methods.purpose: Chunk-backed block read and flagged write path.

methods.detail: Steps grid up to 200 iterations honoring stopOnLiquid and bounding-box flags. Calls Block.collisionRayTrace per cell. Used by Entity.rayTrace and interaction.
methods.name: rayTraceBlocks
methods.purpose: DDA voxel traversal returning block hit or miss.

methods.detail: Iterates block range with border checks, adds block collision boxes, then nearby entity boxes. Feeds Entity.moveEntity resolution.
methods.name: getCollidingBoundingBoxes
methods.purpose: Collects block plus entity boxes intersecting an AABB.

methods.detail: Expands chunk range by margin, delegates to Chunk.getEntitiesWithinAABBForEntity. Powers collision, combat targeting, and sleep safety checks.
methods.name: getEntitiesWithinAABBExcludingEntity
methods.purpose: Chunk-scoped entity query with spectator filter.

methods.detail: Validates chunk loaded, adds players to playerEntities, links chunk and calls onEntityAdded/Removed for render/tracker hooks. Backs S0E/S13.
methods.name: spawnEntityInWorld/removeEntity
methods.purpose: Registers and unregisters entities with chunks and lists.

methods.detail: Handles riding consistency, NaN guards, chunk migration, dead removal, and ITickable tiles. Called each world tick before block ticks.
methods.name: updateEntities/updateEntity
methods.purpose: Ticks weather effects, entities, and tile entities.

methods.detail: Iterates IWorldAccess for playSound, playRecord, broadcastSound, aux SFX, and particle IDs. Server listeners convert to S29/S2A; client renders directly.
methods.name: playSoundAtEntity/spawnParticle
methods.purpose: Fans out audible and visual effects to world accesses.

methods.detail: Base World is no-op; WorldServer overrides to send S19 entity status and S24 block action to trackers. Comment notes legacy Packet 38.
methods.name: setEntityState/addBlockEvent
methods.purpose: Hooks for entity status and block animation events.

World.overview: Abstract block/entity store and simulation hub for server and client. Provides chunk-backed block access, DDA rayTraceBlocks, AABB entity queries, collision lists, and sound/particle fan-out to IWorldAccess. Owns entity/tile tick loops, light, weather, and save metadata.
